International Cheese Federation: May 2019 Archive
This page serves as an archive for May 2019, featuring articles on the Advanced Affinage Certificate, updates on milk prices and trade policy, an announcement for a workshop on curd retailing, and a member spotlight. It provides a snapshot of the International Cheese Federation's activities and industry news for that month.

Yuri Lee 




 


Milk prices firm up under a new rule 

 

Class III and Class IV prices have been climbing since February, a new Class I pricing formula took effect May 1, and a noisier trade picture is making everyone’s planning a little harder.

Registration opens: Workshop on curd retailing 

 

Our June workshop on selling fresh curds at retail opens for registration this week, built for members who make a shelf-stable product but a genuinely perishable one.
